Imagine the Possibilities
South Dakota State University offers graduate programs that are full of proud university tradition, exciting research possibilities and plenty of options to meet your interests. Start your journey with us today!
Apply Now
Application Deadlines
December 15
Fall semester
October 15
Spring semester
Application Notes
Applications submitted after the above deadlines are not guaranteed formal review by the respective department and may not be issued an admission decision.
*If you are a prospective master's or Ph.D. applicant and interested in applying for an engineering degree, please use the EngineeringCAS application. The general application is not needed.
Some departments have earlier deadlines and/or only admit for certain terms! Please check with your specific department of interest before applying.
Apply Now
Application Steps
Application Types Requirements
Let's go!
General Application
Use the General Graduate Application to begin your graduate school journey unless you are applying to a graduate program housed in the Jerome J. Lohr College of Engineering. Those applicants must apply using the appropriate EngineeringCAS link.
Access your application, upload documents or check your application status using our admissions portal.
Open General Application
Open Admissions Portal
Other Application Types
Engineering Applicants
Applicants applying to an engineering graduate program in the Jerome J. Lohr College of Engineering must complete the EngineeringCAS application.
EngineeringCAS Application
Nursing Applicants
Applicants applying to a graduate program in the College of Nursing must complete the NursingCAS application first, and then complete a general SDSU graduate application.
NursingCAS Application
Nondegree Seeking
Not interested in earning a full graduate degree at this time but would like to take graduate-level courses? Apply as a nondegree-seeking graduate student!
Nondegree Seeking
Admission Requirements
Please be aware that some programs have additional requirements or higher minimum requirements. Consult the graduate catalog for program specific requirements. SDSU requires:
A minimum GPA of 3.0 to receive unconditional acceptance.
An official bachelor's degree transcript or evaluation. If you are completing your bachelor's degree at the time of application, you may submit an incomplete transcript. If you are accepted, a complete transcript or transcript evaluation with completed degree will be required by the end of your first semester of coursework.
Domestic Applicants
Graduate admission requirements for U.S. citizens and permanent residents.
Domestic Applicant Requirements
International Applicants
Graduate admission requirements for non-U.S. citizens.
International Applicant Requirements
Current SDSU Students
Current students applying to add an additional credential or are switching programs will not be required to pay the $40 application fee for a second time. Graduating students applying for a new degree must complete the online application.
